patterns: Calculation layers should use positive deduction magnitudes.
Excel/display layers may render deductions as signed negatives, but formulas must add signed cells rather than subtract signed cells.
Koreksi must always reduce gross whether source is positive or negative.
Premi PPH is a net-pay addition and must not be counted in gross total premi.
Worker deductions and employer contributions must not be mixed in net wage deductions.
integration_points: backend payroll calculator -> report rows -> frontend table
frontend aggregation -> displayed totals and export payloads
tax report rows -> tax matrix -> tax Excel
conflict_areas: Many payroll/report/export files have uncommitted changes.
Previous workflow changed sign semantics for koreksi and other income.
There are duplicate formula engines across backend and frontend.
constraints: Planning only; do not edit production code in this step.
Use TDD: failing test first for every fix.
Avoid reverting unrelated dirty worktree changes.
Payroll correctness has higher priority than UI convenience.
